name: Sapphira (Ananias' wife)
title: Deceivers in the Early Church
summary: Sapphira was married to Ananias and a member of the first Christian church in Jerusalem. She and her husband sold a property but withheld part of the money while claiming to give everything to the apostles. Both died as a result of lying to the Holy Spirit, and the event served as a warning about God's holiness within the church.

keyEvents.title: The Sale of the Property
keyEvents.description: Sapphira and Ananias sold a property but secretly agreed to keep back part of the sale price for themselves.

keyEvents.title: Deception Against the Apostles
keyEvents.description: Together with her husband, Sapphira pretended that they were giving the full amount to the church, while in reality they kept back part of it.

keyEvents.title: Peter's Confrontation
keyEvents.description: Three hours after her husband's death, Sapphira arrived at Peter's place, unaware of what had happened. Peter asked her about the sale price, and she lied.

keyEvents.title: Sapphira's Death
keyEvents.description: Peter rebuked Sapphira for testing the Lord's Spirit. She immediately fell dead, was carried out, and buried beside her husband.

keyEvents.title: Fear in the Church
keyEvents.description: The fate of Sapphira and Ananias brought great fear upon the whole church and all who heard about what had happened.
